info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Direct Debit Mandate Management API
info.description: The Direct Debit Mandate Management API allows users to modify existing direct debit mandates for banking transactions. This API supports operations to update details of mandates, enabling users to efficiently manage their payment agreements. Typical consumers include financial institutions and payment processors that require precise control over direct debit structures. With this comprehensive tool, users can ensure that their direct debit arrangements are current and reflect any necessary changes.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific Direct Debit Mandate identified by its resource ID. Ensure that all necessary fields are provided in the request body to successfully update the mandate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update an existing direct debit mandate. The data provided should include the necessary fields to modify the specific mandate identified by its resource ID. Ensure that all required fields are included in the JSON payload.
